scores.notes: Both show a circular pit of pale grey brick with a sandy floor, a stepped section in the back wall, and palms and dry scrub along the rim in daylight; the left looks down from above and the right is at rim level, which fits a change of viewpoint.
Daniel on the left, being lifted, and Daniel standing in the hall on the right are both older men with short grey-white hair, a short grey beard, a lean face and similar skin tone.
Daniel in the hall on the left and the small figure in the den on the right both have short grey hair, a grey beard and an older, lean face.
Daniel being lifted on the left and Daniel in the hall on the right are both older and light-olive-skinned, with short grey-white hair and a trimmed grey beard.
Daniel in the hall on the left has silver-grey hair and a grey beard. The figure standing in the den on the right has dark hair and a dark beard on his head and face.
Daniel being lifted on the left is an older man with grey hair and a grey beard. Daniel standing in the den on the right has dark short hair and a dark beard and looks clearly younger.
Daniel in the den on the left has dark short hair and a dark beard and looks younger. Daniel in the hall on the right has grey hair and a grey beard and is visibly older.
Daniel in the hall on the left and Daniel being lifted in the pit on the right both have short grey hair, a grey trimmed beard and an older, lean face.
The Daniel figure in the den on the left has dark hair and a dark beard. Daniel being lifted on the right, shown at a similar small scale, has clearly white hair and a white beard.

The left pit is built of dark grey stone, with an iron gate at floor level and palace buildings beyond the rim. The right pit is lighter stone, with stairs rising to a barred window under a half-round wooden hood and palms and scrub on the rim; the gate layout and surroundings don't match.
Daniel being lifted on the left has light skin, white hair and a fuller white beard. Daniel on the balcony on the right has clearly darker brown skin on his face and hands.
Daniel on the balcony on the left has grey hair and a grey beard. The Daniel figure in the den on the right has dark hair and a dark beard.
The small Daniel in the den on the left and Daniel being lifted on the right both have short grey hair, a grey beard and an older face.

Both show a pale stone circular pit with a round banded wooden lid over an iron-barred gate, a sandy floor, and palms and dry scrub in flat desert around it. The arrangement fits a change of viewpoint.

Both have grey hair and a trimmed grey beard, but Daniel in the hall on the left has light olive skin on his face and hands. Daniel on the balcony on the right has clearly darker brown skin even though his white tunic is well lit.
